title.narrative: Walter Reed Army Institute of Research Umbrella IAA

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:Strengthen Nigeria's capacity for malaria diagnosis and laboratory quality assurance and control systems, conduct annual laboratory supportive supervision, and maintain the slide bank in one reference laboratory;.Improve the testing rate for suspected malaria cases, and consequently result in improved case management of malaria, rational use of antimalarial drugs, and reduced malaria-associated mortality; and.Strengthen USAID's localization efforts of Nigeria's disease detection and management capability..Malaria contributes significantly to morbidity and mortality of Nigerian children and pregnant women with a national prevalence of 23 percent (Demographic and Health Survey, 2018). The Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (WRAIR) program works collaboratively between the U.S. Department of Defense and the Nigerian Ministry of Defense to strengthen laboratory testing for HIV and malaria. The program provides specialized technical assistance to improve diagnostic capacity at the national and state levels, develops standard operating procedures and provides training in malaria microscopy and rapid diagnostic testing. This activity contributes directly to USAID Nigeria CDCS Development Objective 2, the Embassy's ICS, and is closely aligned with Goal 3 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan..
